scope: in-situ and ground-based atmosphere observation (closer than satellites) + NOAA forecast models
verdict_rule: GREEN = public domain / CC0 / CC BY / CC BY-SA / ODbL / explicit commercial OK, permanently free; GREY = unstated / disclaimer-only / account-gated restrictions; RED = non-commercial, paid, or no-redistribution

sources.name: NOAA MRMS (MESH hail, QPE rain, rotation tracks)
sources.measures: Max estimated hail size, radar-gauge rain, low-level rotation (tornado path proxy)
sources.licence: "NOAA data disseminated through NODD are open to the public and can be used as desired." (attribution requested; no implied endorsement)
sources.in_app: in app (MESH per house: enrich_national.py, metro_build.py, catalog.js)
sources.usefulness: Very high: per-house hail history is the core roof lead
sources.what_we_could_show: Add RotationTrack (tornado swath) and MultiSensor QPE 24/72h for gutter/flood leads on the same 1 km grid

sources.name: NWS Local Storm Reports (LSR) via IEM
sources.platform: Trained spotters, public, emergency mgmt, NWS
sources.measures: Hail size, measured/estimated wind gusts, tornado, tree/power-line damage, flooding, with lat/lon + remark text
sources.licence: "The materials found on this website are in the public domain and may be used freely by anyone for any lawful purpose." Underlying NWS products: "The information on National Weather Service (NWS) Web pages are in the public domain, unless specifically noted otherwise, and may be used without charge for any lawful purpose" (no endorsement implied, do not claim as own)
sources.in_app: not in app (SPC reports are; LSR is the richer superset incl. tree damage remarks)
sources.usefulness: Very high: ground-truth hail and 'tree down on house' near a parcel
sources.what_we_could_show: Pin each spotter report on the globe with size/remark; flag houses within 2 km of hail >=1 in or tree-damage report

sources.name: NOAA SPC storm reports
sources.measures: Hail >=1 in, wind >=58 mph, tornado points
sources.licence: "The information on National Weather Service (NWS) Web pages are in the public domain, unless specifically noted otherwise, and may be used without charge for any lawful purpose" (no endorsement implied, do not claim as own)
sources.in_app: in app (catalog.js; used as hail-day gate)
sources.usefulness: High
sources.what_we_could_show: Already used; keep as gate for MRMS

sources.name: NCEI Storm Events Database
sources.measures: Event narratives, property damage $, hail/wind/tornado/flood by county/zone + begin/end points
sources.licence: "The information on National Weather Service (NWS) Web pages are in the public domain, unless specifically noted otherwise, and may be used without charge for any lawful purpose" (no endorsement implied, do not claim as own) (NOAA/NCEI federal data)
sources.usefulness: High for area history; not per house
sources.what_we_could_show: Already in app

sources.name: NCEI SWDI NEXRAD Level III hail/meso/TVS signatures (NX3HAIL etc.)
sources.measures: Cell-level hail probability and max size, mesocyclone, tornado vortex signatures
sources.resolution: point per radar cell per volume scan
sources.licence: "The information on National Weather Service (NWS) Web pages are in the public domain, unless specifically noted otherwise, and may be used without charge for any lawful purpose" (no endorsement implied, do not claim as own) (NOAA federal data)
sources.usefulness: Medium-high: independent check on MESH, back to 1990s
sources.what_we_could_show: Hail-cell dots with size, cross-check MRMS swath

sources.name: NEXRAD Level II / Level III
sources.measures: Reflectivity, velocity, dual-pol (hail detection), per-tilt volume scans
sources.access: s3://unidata-nexrad-level2 (new bucket; old one deprecated Sep 2025), s3://unidata-nexrad-level3; Google Cloud mirror
sources.licence: "NOAA data disseminated through NODD are open to the public and can be used as desired." (attribution requested; no implied endorsement)
sources.in_app: not in app as raw (only derived MRMS/GLM)
sources.usefulness: Medium: MRMS already distils it; raw useful for 3D storm replay
sources.what_we_could_show: 3D volumetric replay of the storm that hit a block, dot-cloud style above the houses

sources.name: CoCoRaHS volunteer rain, hail and snow
sources.measures: Daily rain, snow, hail reports (size, duration, stone count, damage text)
sources.access: https://data.cocorahs.org/export/exportreports.aspx?ReportType=Hail&Format=CSV&State=TX&ReportDateType=reportdate&StartDate=MM/DD/YYYY&EndDate=MM/DD/YYYY (probed 200 CSV, no key; fields incl. LargestSize, Damage)
sources.licence: "Unless otherwise noted, all CoCoRaHS content and data are released under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 License." Data "freely available to governments, academic institutions and the private sector"
sources.usefulness: High: neighbourhood-scale ground hail with damage notes; dense rain gauges for gutter/overflow and flood leads
sources.what_we_could_show: Hail-pad dots with measured stone size next to MRMS swath; 'your street got 3.1 in rain' gutter trigger

sources.name: NHC / 53rd WRS + NOAA AOC hurricane-hunter recon and dropsondes
sources.measures: Flight-level and surface wind (SFMR), dropsonde profiles in hurricanes
sources.licence: "The information on National Weather Service (NWS) Web pages are in the public domain, unless specifically noted otherwise, and may be used without charge for any lawful purpose" (no endorsement implied, do not claim as own) (NOAA federal; AF reserve data disseminated by NHC)
sources.usefulness: Low-medium: only for landfalling hurricanes; NHC wind-swath products are more directly useful
sources.what_we_could_show: Recon drop points and peak surface wind over a coastal metro after landfall

sources.name: ASOS/AWOS/METAR (incl. ceilometer cloud height, gusts, present weather)
sources.measures: Temp, dewpoint, wind/gusts, pressure, precip, cloud base, visibility, hail/thunder codes
sources.licence: "The information on National Weather Service (NWS) Web pages are in the public domain, unless specifically noted otherwise, and may be used without charge for any lawful purpose" (no endorsement implied, do not claim as own); IEM: "The materials found on this website are in the public domain and may be used freely by anyone for any lawful purpose."
sources.usefulness: Medium: peak gusts and freeze cycles near a house
sources.what_we_could_show: Already in app; add peak-gust-of-storm label per block

sources.name: USCRN / USRCRN (Climate Reference Network)
sources.measures: High-accuracy air temp, precip (triple gauge), soil moisture/temp, solar, surface IR temp
sources.licence: "The information on National Weather Service (NWS) Web pages are in the public domain, unless specifically noted otherwise, and may be used without charge for any lawful purpose" (no endorsement implied, do not claim as own) (NOAA/NCEI federal data)
sources.usefulness: Low-medium: sparse; ground truth for heat/freeze stress and soil moisture (foundation/tree drought)
sources.what_we_could_show: Nearest-reference-station heat days and soil drought index per metro

sources.name: GHCN-Daily (COOP + other daily stations)
sources.measures: Daily temp, precip, snow
sources.licence: "The information on National Weather Service (NWS) Web pages are in the public domain, unless specifically noted otherwise, and may be used without charge for any lawful purpose" (no endorsement implied, do not claim as own) (NOAA/NCEI)
sources.usefulness: Medium
sources.what_we_could_show: Already in app

sources.name: NOAA MADIS (public categories: non-mesonet surface, radiosonde, profilers)
sources.measures: Surface obs, radiosonde, NOAA/multi-agency profilers
sources.licence: Public-category sets 'available without restriction'; mesonet sets: 'Redistribution of data in distribution categories other than "full distribution" is not allowed. This includes placing the data itself on public web pages.'
sources.usefulness: Medium; but the green parts duplicate ASOS/IGRA which we get directly
sources.what_we_could_show: Skip: use ASOS/IGRA directly; mesonet tier is restricted

sources.name: Synoptic Data (MesoWest successor) mesonet API
sources.measures: Dense surface obs, gusts, fire weather
sources.cost: Commercial paid; free 'Open Access' is non-commercial
sources.licence: 'Open Access (non-commercial)'; commercial offerings for 'any for-profit operations' are paid plans
sources.usefulness: Would be high (dense gusts) but licence fails
sources.what_we_could_show: Excluded

sources.name: Oklahoma Mesonet (example of state mesonets)
sources.measures: Surface obs, soil, rain
sources.licence: 'All Oklahoma Mesonet data are copyrighted... no redistribution of the data is allowed.' Commercial: 'Standard fees for data and data services apply'
sources.usefulness: Excluded; other state mesonets have their own custom terms - default GREY until each is checked
sources.what_we_could_show: Excluded

sources.name: NOAA IGRA v2 (Integrated Global Radiosonde Archive)
sources.platform: Weather balloons (radiosondes), ~2,800 stations global, ~90 US launching twice daily
sources.measures: Temp, humidity, wind, pressure profiles; derived stability
sources.licence: "The information on National Weather Service (NWS) Web pages are in the public domain, unless specifically noted otherwise, and may be used without charge for any lawful purpose" (no endorsement implied, do not claim as own) (NOAA/NCEI federal data)
sources.usefulness: Low for per-house leads (storm-environment context: CAPE, freezing level for hail)
sources.what_we_could_show: Balloon profile column over the nearest launch site, coloured by temp, on the dot globe

sources.name: NWS upper-air soundings (real-time) + IEM RAOB archive
sources.measures: Same as IGRA, real time
sources.licence: "The information on National Weather Service (NWS) Web pages are in the public domain, unless specifically noted otherwise, and may be used without charge for any lawful purpose" (no endorsement implied, do not claim as own); IEM: "The materials found on this website are in the public domain and may be used freely by anyone for any lawful purpose."
sources.usefulness: Low
sources.what_we_could_show: Live balloon columns; same as IGRA

sources.name: University of Wyoming sounding archive
sources.measures: Text/CSV soundings and skew-T
sources.licence: No licence or terms stated on the page (contact address only)
sources.usefulness: Low; same data via IGRA/NWS which are green
sources.what_we_could_show: Skip; use IGRA

sources.name: SondeHub radiosonde telemetry (amateur receivers)
sources.platform: ~1,460 hobbyist receiver stations tracking NWS/WMO balloons
sources.measures: Full-rate balloon flight tracks, landing spots
sources.licence: "Radiosonde and Amateur balloon telemetry data captured in the SondeHub database is licensed under Creative Commons BY-SA v2.0."
sources.usefulness: Low for leads; strong visual value (share-alike applies to derived data we publish)
sources.what_we_could_show: Animated balloon flight paths over the metro, fine glowing dots, matching the dot-globe style

sources.name: NOAA GML ozonesondes
sources.platform: Balloon ozonesondes (Boulder, Hilo, South Pole etc.)
sources.measures: Ozone profiles
sources.licence: GML file header 'USE OF NOAA GML DATA': 'These data are made freely available to the public and the scientific community'; NOAA federal work
sources.usefulness: None for maintenance
sources.what_we_could_show: Skip

sources.name: NOAA wind profilers (NPN retired 2014; Multi-Agency Profiler via MADIS)
sources.measures: Wind profiles 0-16 km
sources.licence: MADIS lists 'Multi-Agency Profiler' as 'available without restriction' but access needs an account
sources.usefulness: None for per-house
sources.what_we_could_show: Skip (account route, low value)

sources.name: Vaisala NLDN / GLD360
sources.measures: Cloud-to-ground strikes, peak current
sources.licence: Proprietary, paid (already excluded by earth-data licence audit)
sources.usefulness: Would be high (strike-at-house for surge/roof)
sources.what_we_could_show: Excluded; use GOES GLM (in app) instead

sources.name: Blitzortung.org
sources.measures: Strike locations
sources.licence: 'The station owners can use the raw data for all non-commercial purposes.'
sources.usefulness: Excluded
sources.what_we_could_show: Excluded

sources.name: GOES GLM (satellite, for reference)
sources.measures: Total lightning
sources.licence: "NOAA data disseminated through NODD are open to the public and can be used as desired." (attribution requested; no implied endorsement)
sources.usefulness: Medium
sources.what_we_could_show: Already in app; only green lightning option found

sources.name: EPA AQS (regulatory monitors)
sources.measures: PM2.5, PM10, O3, NO2, SO2, CO, lead
sources.access: https://aqs.epa.gov/aqsweb/airdata/download_files.html (pre-generated files, no key); AQS API needs free key
sources.licence: EPA Data License (US government public domain data)
sources.usefulness: Medium: smoke/dust days drive HVAC filter, window/solar/roof cleaning leads
sources.what_we_could_show: Already in app; add wildfire-smoke-day count per block

sources.name: EPA AirNow (real-time)
sources.measures: AQI
sources.licence: Previously audited grey: real-time feed carries partner (state/tribal/Canada) data not open as a whole
sources.usefulness: Medium
sources.what_we_could_show: Use AQS instead

sources.name: OpenAQ
sources.measures: PM, O3, NO2
sources.licence: Per-provider licences; not open as a whole
sources.usefulness: Medium
sources.what_we_could_show: Only usable per-provider where the provider is green (e.g. EPA)

sources.name: PurpleAir sensors
sources.measures: PM2.5 at street level
sources.licence: Custom ToS: 'Grantback license', 'Limited data distribution to one-level removed... cannot resell data'; other uses via 'Data Licensing Inquiry'
sources.usefulness: Would be high (hyperlocal smoke)
sources.what_we_could_show: Excluded

sources.name: AAAAI National Allergy Bureau pollen counts
sources.measures: Daily pollen/mold counts
sources.licence: '(c) 2026 American Academy of Allergy, Asthma & Immunology. All Rights Reserved.'
sources.usefulness: Low-medium (HVAC filter/duct cleaning seasons)
sources.what_we_could_show: Excluded; no green US pollen network found

sources.name: NOAA GML tall towers and greenhouse-gas network
sources.measures: CO2, CH4, CO concentrations
sources.licence: 'These data are made freely available to the public and the scientific community' (file header 'USE OF NOAA GML DATA'); NOAA federal work
sources.usefulness: None for maintenance
sources.what_we_could_show: Skip

sources.name: AmeriFlux eddy-covariance towers
sources.measures: CO2/H2O/energy fluxes, met, soil
sources.access: https://ameriflux.lbl.gov/ (download requires free account + stated purpose)
sources.licence: 'Most site PIs now share their sites' data under the CC-BY-4.0 license'... 'free to Share... and/or Adapt... for any purpose'; some sites remain under the Legacy policy
sources.usefulness: None for per-house leads
sources.what_we_could_show: Skip

sources.name: NOAA HRRR (3 km rapid-refresh model)
sources.measures: Hourly forecasts 18-48 h: gusts, hail proxy (updraft helicity), rain, temp
sources.licence: "NOAA data disseminated through NODD are open to the public and can be used as desired." (attribution requested; no implied endorsement)
sources.usefulness: Medium-high: 'storm coming tomorrow' crew pre-positioning; must be labelled forecast
sources.what_we_could_show: Next-24h gust and updraft-helicity field over the metro; pre-storm list of blocks

sources.name: NWS NDFD (official gridded forecast)
sources.measures: 7-day temp, wind gusts, precip, snow, ice
sources.licence: "The information on National Weather Service (NWS) Web pages are in the public domain, unless specifically noted otherwise, and may be used without charge for any lawful purpose" (no endorsement implied, do not claim as own)
sources.usefulness: Medium: freeze/ice-dam and wind-event outlook
sources.what_we_could_show: Freeze-night and ice-accretion forecast per block (pipe/gutter/ice-dam leads)
